title: VPS and Dedicated Servers Cancellation and Money-Back Terms
content:
## Terms

1. Only the customer can cancel a server, and a scheduled cancellation may be withdrawn before it takes effect.
2. A money-back refund of the initial term line is given only for a cancellation made on or before the server's opening date plus the tier's money-back period in calendar days.
3. The window adds whole calendar days to the opening date, counting the next day as day 1, and the last day is included; a tier whose money-back period is 0 has no money-back guarantee, and setup fees and add-ons are never refunded under it.
4. A dedicated server cannot be cancelled with immediate effect, and its cancellation takes effect the tier's notice period in calendar days after the request, or at the term end when that is later, with no refund.
5. Each charge is refunded only once.

These terms govern every server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range.

## The money-back window

The clock starts from the opening date on the server's holding record; the customer's recollection of when the server was ordered is not the evidence. The day after the opening date is day 1, and the last day of the window is the opening date plus the tier's money-back period in calendar days. A cancellation made on that last day is inside the window; a cancellation made on the day after it is outside.

**Hypothetical boundary cases.** The period of 12 days below is an invented input, not a Harborline figure. For a server opened on 10 April with a 12-day period, day 1 is 11 April and the last day is 22 April.

| Cancellation made on | Inside the money-back window |
|---|---|
| 22 April (the last day) | Yes, the initial term line is refunded |
| 23 April (the day after) | No money-back refund |

A refund given under the window covers the initial term line only. A setup fee line and any add-on line on the same server stay billed.

## Scheduled cancellations and the dedicated notice period

- A scheduled cancellation sets a date on which it will take effect and turns auto-renew off. Withdrawing it before that date clears the date and turns auto-renew back on.
- A VPS may also be cancelled with immediate effect.
- For a dedicated server the effective date is the later of two dates: the request date plus the notice period in calendar days, and the term end.

**Hypothetical notice cases.** The notice period of 45 days below is an invented input. A request made on 1 May gives 15 June as the end of notice.

| Term end of the dedicated server | Cancellation takes effect |
|---|---|
| 1 June | 15 June, the end of notice, which is later |
| 30 June | 30 June, the term end, which is later |

In both cases no refund is given on the dedicated server's cancellation.

## One refund per charge

A charge that already has a refund line referring to it is not refunded again. The evidence is the server's billing lines, where each refund line records the charge it refunds.
